rationale: Anya is a founder in ML infrastructure with experience building at AIFlow and genspace.ai, while Nathan is an AI researcher and investor focused on embodied AI, robotics, and physics-informed learning at Afore and Extropic. They operate in complementary parts of the ML ecosystem—Anya's infrastructure expertise could support the systems Nathan's research teams are building, and Nathan's deep conviction in hardware-software co-design and real-world data grounding aligns with infrastructure challenges that enable next-generation AI.
intro_message: Anya Moonbae, meet Nathan Yu — both building in ML but from different angles (infrastructure vs. embodied AI research), and Nathan's physics-informed systems perspective could inform how Anya thinks about infrastructure for real-world AI.
